description: Search the AkulaCyber catalogue of GL.iNet Comet KVM over IP devices and their accessories (9 products) and return the matches with current price in UAH, stock and product page URL. Use it first when the user describes a need or a feature or names a product loosely; then use akulacyber_get_product for one product's full details, or akulacyber_compare_kvms to set KVM models side by side. Every query word must occur in a product's names, model codes, summary or specifications, in Ukrainian, Russian or English; results come in catalogue order. Without a query it lists the whole catalogue or one category. When nothing matches, the result is an error that lists every product.

category.description: kvm: KVM over IP devices; accessory: add-ons such as the ATX Board, PoE Splitter or Fingerbot.

lang.description: Language of the texts and page URLs in the answer: uk (Ukrainian, the default), ru (Russian) or en (English). Use the language the user writes in.

query.description: Words that must all match, in any of the three languages, e.g. "PoE", "4 computers", "GL-RM10". Leave it out to list everything.

name: akulacyber_search_products
title: Search AkulaCyber products
